_why: The statements PostgresBackend.update_rows and create_rows compose, for the field shapes the kernel composes natively. Two tests read this file: harness/test_shims.py drives the FORK's backend against a stub model and asserts it produces these strings, and kernel/tests/pure.rs asserts the kernel's composer produces them. One literal, derived twice, so a change on either side fails against the other rather than against a copy of itself. Regenerate with harness/write_sql_contract.py after an intended change to the fork's composition.

cases.name: values, a whole-value translated column
cases.sql:
UPDATE "res_partner"
                SET "title" = CASE WHEN "__tmp"."title"::JSONB IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
                        COALESCE("res_partner"."title", jsonb_build_object(
                            'en_US', jsonb_path_query_first("__tmp"."title"::JSONB, '$.*')
                        )) || "__tmp"."title"::JSONB
                    END
                FROM (VALUES (%s, %s)) AS "__tmp"("id", "title")
                WHERE "res_partner"."id" = "__tmp"."id"

cases.name: uniform, a whole-value translated column binds its value three times
cases.sql:
UPDATE "res_partner" SET "title" = CASE WHEN %s::JSONB IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE
                        COALESCE("res_partner"."title", jsonb_build_object(
                            'en_US', jsonb_path_query_first(%s::JSONB, '$.*')
                        )) || %s::JSONB
                    END WHERE "id" = ANY(%s)
